title: Record one ordinary-work bound for the PR6353 supplier.
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Audit of one ordinary-work funding inequality for the frozen PR6353 supplier word. Two independent charge walks agree. The local allowance is 5496694, strictly below 10^7. The caller-event raw bound is 194902768, strictly below 10^9.

This is a scoped funding check. It is not a new query demand, a scalar-saving construction, or a kappa improvement. Selected kappa stays 781451/250000000. Compiler predicates, outer predicates, native phases, and LOCAL stages 2–19 remain. The five framework assumptions remain.

## Task and overlap

Base commit 7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a. Task joint-query-controller, scope changed. The supplier bytes are PR6353 head db2a20bc50bc7a8a4db931af85ce7f012ae7c3c3, SHA256 0c83c1f1dee8c9442558719510a61b89f38c2dbfc8fb565ba035660d2a68d928. The caller is research/balanced-query-tree/CONTROLLER.json, blob 1f2e375b24aba5fb25580dfea7fab7a2049f3eb8, 353 events.

The card asks whether a new query demand removes work. The live handoff after PR6361 asks for one physical contact and then source-specific funding. Fork branch cursor/p104-6353-stage1-local-contact-7c18 already binds the stage-1 contact, so this package does not repeat it. PR #6359 already recounts the recursive invoice and leaves ordinary funding open. PR #6360 and PR #6361 cover the width-one frame-1094 matrices and the formal Laurent endpoint.

A failed local allowance would block the conditional claim 0.00315057. This strict pass does not raise kappa.

## Validation

Python 3.12, standard library only:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-one-ordinary-bound
```

Marker PASS_ONE_ORDINARY_WORK_BOUND. The same command with -O passes; failures are ValueError. Controls reject cap equality, substituting the supplier program length 17657 (that substitution is 256089712), restoring helper 703 to its old rank-9 frame, and a SCALE by 3.

A session run of the author constructor at db2a20bc reproduced the vendored payload. The registered replay hashes those bytes and does not rerun the constructor. The charge walk does not replay scalar rows, native phases, or the moment engine.

## Credit

Supplier word, formula, and nine output contractions: Ali Romman, with Cinna Davis and the P104 native-channel lineage, DreamingOfClouds for the PR6349 ports, and the PR6348 caller. Recursive invoice: ToikY, PR6359. Stage-1 contact: the fork branch named above. Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

1. Check the compiler threshold and all 54 outer predicates at the same PR6353 head. The ordinary-work slack does not discharge them.
2. Bind LOCAL stages 2 through 19. Stage 1 is already on cursor/p104-6353-stage1-local-contact-7c18, and one stage does not transfer.

## Workflow feedback

The published raw expression reads the caller event count, 353. Substituting the supplier program length, 17657, is a different number. Stating both lengths next to the formula keeps a later audit from mixing them.
